privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
In compliance with the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties, the following is informed:

Data Controller

MAKU AGENCY, S.A. de C.V. (hereinafter, “MAKU”), with address in Mexico City, is responsible for the use and protection of your personal data.

What data do we collect?

We may collect the following data through our website:

  • Full name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Company or project information
  • Any additional information voluntarily provided by the user

What do we use your information for?

We use your data to:

  • Follow up on contact requests
  • Send information about our services
  • Prepare commercial proposals
  • Maintain communication with clients and prospects
  • Improve our services and digital experience

Use of tracking technologies

Our website may use cookies, pixels, and similar technologies (Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics) to:

  • Analyze browsing behavior
  • Measure campaign performance
  • Improve user experience

Data transfer

Your data will not be shared with third parties without your consent, except when necessary to comply with legal obligations or with technology providers that support the operation of the website.

ARCO Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access your data
  • Rectify it
  • Cancel it
  • Object to its use

You can exercise these rights by sending an email to: makuagency{'@'}gmail.com

Changes to the policy

MAKU reserves the right to modify this policy at any time. Updates will be published on this same website.

The information presented on the site does not constitute a binding offer, and services are formalized through specific proposals and agreements.

Reproduction, distribution, or use without prior authorization is prohibited.

Limitation of liability

MAKU does not guarantee specific results derived from the implementation of marketing strategies, as these depend on multiple external factors.

Use of the information on this site is at the user’s own risk.

External links

This site may contain links to third parties. MAKU is not responsible for the content or policies of such sites.

Jurisdiction

This site is governed by the laws of Mexico.

Any disputes shall be resolved before the courts of Mexico City.

cookie.title: Cookies Policy
cookie.body:
This website uses cookies to improve the user experience.

What are cookies?

They are files stored in your browser that allow recognition of your browsing behavior.

What types do we use?

  • Analytics cookies (Google Analytics)
  • Advertising cookies (Meta Ads, Google Ads)
  • Site functionality cookies

What do we use them for?

  • Analyze traffic
  • Improve content
  • Personalize ads

How to disable them

You can configure your browser to block or delete cookies at any time.

projects.title: Most brands come with a specific need. Our role is to understand what the brand actually needs to grow.
projects.subtitle: That means looking beyond the initial request and building strategies that strengthen the brand, its connection with customers, and its long-term performance.

symbols.title: Symbols carved into stone. Signs painted on walls. Traces that remained long after the moment passed.

subtitle.1: We believe branding and marketing truly matter when they help a brand connect, stand out, and perform better as a business.
subtitle.2: At the core, the question is simple: why should people care about your brand? Our role is to help brands find that answer, and build the strategy to make it clear, relevant, and consistent.

items.title: MAKU means to leave a mark, something that is traced, recognized, and remembered.
items.subtitle: A mark that stays.
items.text: That meaning defines how we think about brands. Not as visuals or slogans, but as what remains after an experience. What people remember. What becomes part of their lives.

items.title: Our yellow exists to highlight that mark, to bring forward what truly matters in every brand, business, and concept.
items.subtitle: Our colors
items.text: Because when something is built with meaning, it doesn’t disappear. It stays. It’s recognized. It leaves a mark.

p.1: Michelle Peniche is a Marketing Specialist & MBA with a strong focus on brand strategy and startup concept creation. Passionate about marketing and creative thinking, she brings a strategic, business-driven approach to every project.
p.2: Having lived in three countries and worked with global brands such as PepsiCo, Colgate, and Steve Madden, Michelle leads MAKU with a clear belief: brands grow when strategy and creativity work together.
